action.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(debit - credit) FROM gl_lines WHERE entity_id = 'US01' AND period = '2026-03' AND account_id = '6400' AND dept_id = 'MKT'), 0) AS actual, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM budgets WHERE entity_id = 'US01' AND period = '2026-03' AND account_id = '6400' AND dept_id = 'MKT'), 0) AS budget, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(debit - credit) FROM gl_lines WHERE entity_id = 'US01' AND period = '2026-03' AND account_id = '6400' AND dept_id = 'MKT'), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM budgets WHERE entity_id = 'US01' AND period = '2026-03' AND account_id = '6400' AND dept_id = 'MKT'), 0) AS variance
